description: AGHJ (2025) Appendix A.3, 953 keywords, literal case-insensitive whole-token match on metricOther
Three-state labels (1/0/Unknown); 0 requires positive non-ESG evidence; Unknown for placeholders and unmatched text
metric and metricOther read jointly; only time-consistent metric labels used; 2018-taxonomy ESG labels and ISS metricType ESG categories never used as evidence
Blank metric+metricOther: time-consistent financial metricType (Accounting / Stock Price = Market-related ...) admitted as structured context -> 0; text-only label kept Unknown
Rules consume matched spans in priority order (masks -> routed phrases -> strict -> extended -> ambiguous -> adjacent -> placeholders -> non-ESG)

Masks for false positives found in data: safety and soundness, clinical safety data, accident-year, cost/debt reduction (no longer a keyword), capital recycling, minority investment, business 'environment', financial 'sustainable', company/segment names (Peoples Gas, Hess, Clean Energy Businesses, Sam's Club, Workday, NOV), real-estate 'communities', AML leukaemia, PV, 'inclusive of', audience/viewers, 'partly offset'

Customer satisfaction/experience/retention, product/patient/food safety, healthcare quality, privacy/fair lending, utility service reliability (SAIDI/SAIFI), community engagement -> Extended-only (task brief 4.4)
Generic compliance, regulatory exams, risk management, internal controls, SOX, audit, cybersecurity, AML/BSA -> 0/0 flagged ESG-adjacent (task brief 4.3)
Talent management, succession planning, leadership development, culture, HR, hiring, teamwork -> 0/0 flagged (task brief 4.2); specific engagement/retention/turnover/training/wellbeing stay Strict S
Wind/solar project execution, renewable portfolio growth/availability -> 0/0 flagged (business-line economic meaning); renewable energy adoption/share/carbon-free capacity stays Strict E
Energy efficiency / DSM (cost vs environment), bare water/waste/green/clean/renewables, notices of violation without environmental context, bare integrity/social/turnover -> Strict Unknown
Added safety expressions absent from AGHJ: EH&S, HS&E, H&S, near miss (no hyphen), days away restricted (variants), life-changing events, medical aid, serious incidents
Added: flaring/flare volumes, reportable/significant/off-property releases, scrubbers, reclamation, leak detection, particulate
Added: D&I, DE&I, ethical conduct, associate satisfaction/experience/development, corporate well-being, retain talent, staff/teller/labor turnover, board evaluation
ESG/CSR/citizenship/sustainability not forced into E/S/G: pillar flags Unknown unless a specific pillar term co-occurs ('sustainability' then treated as qualifier)
Rules frozen before drawing the independent validation sample (Validation/validation_sample_v1.0_KEY_local.csv)
Full re-review of v1.0 on the data: every suspicious pattern tested on real texts; findings in Documentation/review_findings_v1.1.csv

Bare 'governance' no longer Strict G (task brief 4.3 requires specific governance content); now Strict Unknown. Strict G = corporate governance, board, shareholder rights, say-on-pay, governance ratings
ESG products / segment sales / ESG AUM are business lines -> 0/0 flagged (were Strict GEN)
Government relations / lobbying / legislative advocacy -> 0/0 flagged (government relations was Extended)
Customer/patient/member engagement routed to Extended before the employee-engagement rule ('Customer Engagement Index' was Strict S)
'partner' removed as an employee noun; retention recognised at a distance ('retention and development of high-potential employees'); word boundary on 'mental health'
Worker radiation exposure (collective dose, RFO dose), loss of containment / process fluid containment, LCE acronym; protected 'safe/healthy work environment'
Community Reinvestment Act, health equity, animal welfare / cage-free, coal ash, Medicare STARS

+ 'satisfaction of' (fulfilment), insurance 'individual' product lines, discretionary cash flow/spend, social media, community count (now non-ESG evidence), segment names (corrugated and recycling, user-experience segment, environmental-services segment), 'diverse' word boundary (Diversey)
Non-ESG vocabulary extended (balance sheet, CASM/RASM, dayrates, LIFO, rating agencies, diversification, mining volumes, active users, clinical-dose milestones ...) -> fewer spurious Unknowns
A pillar-specific ambiguous hit leaves that pillar Unknown when the text is Strict ESG via another pillar (e.g. 'Safety and Governance' -> G Unknown, not 0)
Extended-only is Unknown (not 1) when Strict is Unknown and Extended is 1
text_id = 'T' + first 10 hex of SHA-1(text_key): stable across versions; human labels join on text_key / sample_id
